reviews.body:
Good catch. A default that points at a retired model means `k8sgpt auth add --backend anthropic` with no `--model` just doesn't work, and it's easy to miss.

I read the diff. Both copies of the default move together (`cmd/auth/add.go` and `pkg/ai/anthropic.go`), the existing tests compare against the constants rather than the literal string, and no other code or docs reference `claude-3-5-sonnet-latest` (the entries in `SUPPORTED_MODELS.md` are Bedrock model IDs, which this doesn't touch). Keeping the sampling parameters as they are and handling a newer default in a follow-up keeps this PR a small, safe fix, so that sounds good.

Looks good to me. The build and test workflows haven't run on this head yet, and the License Compliance failure is already on `main`, so it isn't from this change.

Re-checked at bc80b39: the new commit is a merge of upstream `main` with no change to `cmd/auth/add.go` or `pkg/ai/anthropic.go`, so the approval stands at this head. License Compliance is green now that #1850 is settled; build and tests still need the fork-workflow approval before they run, so no merge sign-off from me yet.

The blocker from my last review has cleared: build and golangci-lint ran at bc80b39 and are green, alongside validate, DCO, EasyCLA, License Compliance and codecov. Head is unchanged from the approved one.

Good to merge.
